not_covered.text: Qatar's foreign ministry says that they are working to resume ceasefire negotiations between Iran and the United States.

not_covered.topic: Economic impact of the 2026 Iran war
not_covered.text: The Statistical Center of Iran reports that the country's gross domestic product contracted 10.1% year-on-year from late March to late June, during the war, amid longstanding sanctions and currency depreciation.

The National Hurricane Center reports that Tropical Depression Six strengthened into Tropical Storm Fay amidst an unusually quiet Atlantic hurricane season caused by El Niño, becoming the sixth named storm of the season.
The Democratic Republic of the Congo launches vaccinations for frontline workers amdist the Ebola outbreak in the country.

not_covered.topic: Assassination of Jovenel Moïse, Haiti–United States relations
not_covered.text: Haiti sends 18 suspects in the July 2021 assassination of President Jovenel Moïse to the United States to face federal charges related to the killing.

Four unauthorized miners are killed in a shooting targeting a vehicle by unidentified gunmen in Barkin Ladi, Plateau State, Nigeria.

One child is killed and two others are injured in a stabbing attack in the Blue Mountains of New South Wales, Australia. The children's mother, who was also hospitalised with injuries, is the chief suspect.
Japanese triathlete {{ill|Takumi Hojo|ja|北條巧}} wins the first gold medal of the 2026 Asian Games.
